flow.name: Create Maintenance Work Orders From Asset Schedule

nodes.name: Log: DC CREATE MAIN WO SCHEDULE
Query: GET schedules for active assets

data.query:
query Query($where: MaintenanceScheduleWhereInput, $orderBy: [MaintenanceScheduleOrderByInput!], $first: Int, $after: String) {
  maintenanceSchedule(where: $where, orderBy: $orderBy, first: $first, after: $after) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        number
        frequencyQuantity
        active
        specialInstructions
        startAt
        nextScheduleAt
        checklistId
        checklist {
          id
          number
          description
        }
        frequencyTypeId
        frequencyType {
          id
          name
          calendar
          fixedDateByMonth
          manual
          productCycles
          productionHours
          system
          usable
          workcenterCycles
          color
          customData
          integrationData
        }
        assetId
        asset {
          id
          number
          currentCycles
          currentHours
          lifetimeCycles
          lifetimeHours
          serialized
          brand
          description
          modelNumber
          serialNumber
          inServiceAt
          lastResetAt
          newAt
          purchaseAt
          customData
          statusId
          typeId
          groupId
          supplierId
          workcenterId
        }
        assetGroupId
        assetGroup {
          id
          name
          usable
          customData
        }
        responsibilityId
        responsibility{
          id
          name
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

data.transform:
{
  "SUCCESS": true,
  "MESSAGE": "Maint Workorders " 
    & $.createWorkOrder.id 
    & " and WorkOrderProcessDistributions "
    & $.createWorkOrderProcessDistribution.id
    & " and WorkOrderProcessDistributionGroups "
    & $.createWorkOrderProcessDistributionGroup.id
    & " and CalendarEvents "
    & $.createCalendarEvent.id
    & " created successfully. "
}

/* Check for all expected items (create success) */
$not($isNilOrEmpty(createWorkOrder))
and
$not($isNilOrEmpty(createWorkOrderProcessDistributionGroup))
and
$not($isNilOrEmpty(createCalendarEvent))
and
$not($isNilOrEmpty(createWorkOrderProcessDistribution))

nodes.name: Query: Get maint workorders matching schedules

data.transform: $.createPayload

/* 

Stop if there are no Maint WOs to create against the assets

*/

$count($.createPayload) > 0
